name: Sausage and White Bean Skillet
summary: Smoked sausage and white beans simmered in tomato. One pan, twenty-five minutes.

ingredients.name: white kidney beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sausage rounds and brown 4–5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook 4 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and paprika for 30 seconds.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and add the white beans. Stir to combine.
Simmer over medium-low heat for 10 minutes, mashing a few beans against the side to thicken the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper and serve. Good with bread to mop up the sauce.

glutenFree.notes: Beans and tomatoes are naturally gluten-free. Most smoked kielbasa is gluten-free, but check the label or use a certified gluten-free sausage.

budgetNotes: Smoked kielbasa is cheaper per gram than fresh sausage and keeps for weeks.
Any white bean works — navy or cannellini.
Stretch it over rice if you need a fifth portion.
